svg.aria-label: Removing after the test: first wait for the yellow Cell On light to go out, then unplug the leads, open the holder, take out the cell with plastic tweezers and handle it per after-test handling. Wipe the contacts with isopropanol and let them air dry. After high-temperature tests the holder and cell are hot; wear heat-resistant gloves or wait for them to cool. Tape both terminals of a charged cell with insulating tape.

text.style: fill:rgb(19, 28, 38);fill-opacity:1;stroke:none;stroke-opacity:1;stroke-width:1px;stroke-dasharray:none;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"IBM Plex Sans", "Noto Sans SC", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700

svg.text: Done: light off → unplug → cell out → wipe
